title: Apply a patch with eyes open

rows: clean copy of the base — git apply --check
clean — patch fits the base exactly
diverged copy (requirements.txt changed elsewhere) — git apply --3way
conflict — the copy had moved on since the patch was made

source.label: git apply, twice, for real
source.detail: a clean textual apply was never mistaken for a behaviour match — the diverged case really conflicts, and that is shown, not hidden.

etl.extract: the patch + the destination's current state
etl.transform: conflicts, divergence and local edits explained before anything changes

gap: An apply-with-preview UI is the remaining piece; both real outcomes are here.
honesty: A clean textual apply was never mistaken for a behaviour match — the diverged copy really conflicted.
